title: Unimodality conjecture for the Bernstein basis square-sum
statement:
Let $B_n$ be the Bernstein operator with basis polynomials $b_{nk}(x)=\binom{n}{k}x^k(1-x)^{n-k}$, and define

$$
\varphi_n(x):=\sum_{k=0}^{n}b_{nk}^2(x),\qquad x\in[0,1].
$$

**Unimodality conjecture.** The function $\varphi_n$ is decreasing on $[0,\frac12]$ and increasing on $[\frac12,1]$. This predicts that the coefficient governing the Bernstein Chebyshev–Grüss bound is symmetric and minimized at the midpoint; the source gives no resolution of the conjecture.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.7908

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2014).
source_name: Heiner Gonska, Ioan Raşa and Maria-Daniela Rusu, “Chebyshev-Grüss-type inequalities via discrete oscillations”, arXiv:1401.7908 (2014).
